papers.source: Real UCEST105 December 2024 paper (2024 scheme), transcribed verbatim in demo/sample-paper-raw.md; syllabus from data/ktu-2024-index.json
highlights: Out-of-scope questions 7, 8, 15, 16 all assess Module 4, which the teacher declared out of scope.
31 in-scope topics earn zero marks, including recursion on the call stack, modularization and Numpy arrays.
Module 1=25%, 2=25%, 3=25% - the answerable mark share per module.
Question 11 a) prints overlapping grade bands, flagged as a marking hazard with a concrete rewrite.
Persona timing: weak 144m (tight), average 94m (comfortable), strong 72m (comfortable) against a 150-minute paper.
